prompt: What is the main purpose of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)?

options.text: To help organisations identify capabilities and plan their move to the cloud
options.explanation: Correct. AWS CAF is guidance for cloud transformation and business outcomes.

options.text: To review a single workload against architectural best practices
options.explanation: That describes a Well-Architected review.

options.text: To estimate the monthly cost of AWS services
options.explanation: That describes the AWS Pricing Calculator.
That describes AWS Database Migration Service.

explanation: AWS CAF works at the level of the organisation, not a single workload.

prompt: A company wants to move an application to AWS quickly, without changing the application. Which migration strategy is this?

options.explanation: Correct. Rehosting, or lift and shift, moves an application without changes.
Refactoring redesigns the application to use cloud-native features.
Repurchasing replaces the application with a different product.
Retiring decommissions the application.

explanation: The clue is moving without changes.

prompt: A company decides to stop running its own customer management application and to subscribe to a software as a service product instead. Which migration strategy is this?

options.explanation: Correct. Repurchasing replaces an application with a different product, such as software as a service.
Replatforming moves the same application with some optimisation.
Retaining keeps the application where it is.
Rehosting moves the same application without changes.

explanation: The application is replaced rather than moved, which is repurchase.

prompt: A company must move a production database to AWS. The source database has to stay in use until the switch, and changes must keep flowing to the new database. Which AWS service supports this?

options.explanation: Correct. AWS DMS can keep replicating changes so that source and target stay in sync.
CloudFront delivers content to users.
This tool reviews workloads against best practices.
Compute Optimizer recommends rightsizing changes.

explanation: Ongoing replication is the clue that points to AWS DMS.

references.title: What is AWS Database Migration Service?

prompt: Which TWO are perspectives of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework?

options.explanation: Correct. Governance is one of the six perspectives.
Correct. People is one of the six perspectives.
Reliability is a Well-Architected pillar, not an AWS CAF perspective.
Sustainability is a Well-Architected pillar, not an AWS CAF perspective.
Elasticity is a benefit of the cloud.

explanation: The perspectives are business, people, governance, platform, security, and operations.
